#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const long long MODULUS = 1000000007;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1, MODULUS) << "\n";
    } else if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p, MODULUS) << "\n";
    } else {
        vector<long long> sequence;
        sequence.push_back(1);
        while (true) {
            long long next_val = (sequence.back() * k) % p;
            if (next_val == sequence[0]) break;
            sequence.push_back(next_val);
        }
        long long length = sequence.size();
        cout << mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / length, MODULUS) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
